name: Blood Diamond

features.name: Chained Reels
features.description: Link reels so they show identical symbols.

features.name: xNudge Wilds
features.description: Stacked wilds that gain multipliers as they nudge.

features.name: xNudge Desire
features.description: Adds one to five xNudge Wilds at random.

review:
Blood Diamond is a 5x4 slot where character symbols land in stacks up to four high and count as that many symbols. Chained Reels activate at random, linking two or more reels so the same symbols land across all of them.

Stacked xNudge Wilds always nudge to full view and gain +1 multiplier per nudge, and xNudge Desire can drop one to five of them onto the reels. If one lands on a chained reel, it copies across every linked reel. Nolimit rates it Extreme volatility, with a 14,780x maximum.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
